description: Fix Stories feature - StoryCompose writes to Supabase but StoriesRail reads from Firestore, causing stories to never appear. Also fix missing expires_at field, reaction storage, and story reply user ID inconsistency.
steps: In src/pages/StoryCompose.tsx: Replace the Supabase insert for stories with a Firestore addDoc to the 'stories' collection. Include user_id, media_url, media_type, audience, created_at (serverTimestamp), expires_at (24 hours from now as ISO string), and a profile object with username/display_name/avatar_url from the auth context profile.
In src/pages/StoryCompose.tsx: Replace the Supabase insert for story_stickers with a Firestore addDoc to a 'story_stickers' collection (or subcollection under the story doc).

In src/components/social/StoryViewer.tsx: Replace the Supabase insert for story_reactions with a Firestore addDoc to a 'story_reactions' collection. Use user.id instead of user.uid for consistency (both are the same value but code should be consistent).

In src/components/social/StoryViewer.tsx: Verify that user.uid references in sendReply are correct (they are equivalent to user.id). Ensure the conversation member_ids and sender_id consistently use user.id.

In src/components/social/StoriesRail.tsx: Verify the expires_at query works with ISO string comparison. The query uses where('expires_at', '>', new Date().toISOString()) which requires expires_at to be stored as an ISO string. Ensure the StoryCompose stores it as an ISO string, not a Firestore Timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: StoryCompose writes story data to Firestore 'stories' collection with all required fields including expires_at
StoriesRail can query and display stories that have not expired
StoryViewer reactions write to Firestore instead of Supabase
TypeScript compiles without errors (NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit)
verification: Run NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit and confirm zero errors
findings: All changes verified with tsc --noEmit (zero errors). StoryCompose now writes to Firestore stories collection with expires_at as ISO string and embedded profile object. StoryViewer reactions migrated to Firestore story_reactions collection. All user.uid references in StoryViewer normalized to user.id. StoriesRail required no changes as it already reads from Firestore with ISO string comparison on expires_at.
